versions.changelog: Modernize for current AsusWRT/AsusWRT-Merlin: add firmware/system diagnostics, Ethernet port status, OpenVPN/WireGuard/VPN client status, alert-friendly health bundle, raw AsusData dumps for newer firmware features, HTTPS port config, and client sorting for top talkers or signal checks.
Initial release: status, clients, who (presence), wan, mesh, find, ping, reboot commands. Config-driven via YAML/JSON/env vars.
